name: Hijack
description: Expert negotiator Sam Nelson is in for the ride of his life—and so is everyone on board with him—after a group of hijackers take control. Sam will try every move in his playbook to take them down...as the stakes grow higher by the second.

videos.title: Final Call
videos.overview: Sam Nelson gets on a flight to London hoping to win back his ex-wife, but something on board feels wrong—and his suspicions are confirmed.

videos.title: 3 Degrees
videos.overview: Spotting an opportunity, Sam executes a plan to get a covert message to authorities on the ground.

videos.title: Draw a Blank
videos.overview: As the UK’s counterterrorism unit learns of Flight KA29, Sam gets involved in a risky plan to take on the hijackers.

videos.title: Not Responding
videos.overview: An incident team in Westminster scrambles to intercept fighter jets. Sam tries contacting the ground once more when a hijacker is injured.

videos.title: Less Than an Hour
videos.overview: Sam attempts to convince the hijackers to land the plane. A list of demands reveals who’s behind the hijacking.

videos.title: Comply Slowly
videos.overview: Faced with an impossible decision, the passengers ready themselves for a fight.

videos.title: Brace Brace Brace
videos.overview: A new threat emerges on board as Sam struggles to control the chaos unfolding around him.

videos.title: Signal
videos.overview: Two years after Flight KA29's hijacking, Sam Nelson is thrust into another life-threatening ordeal—but this time it's personal.

videos.title: Control
videos.overview: Sam urges Otto to keep his cool as passengers begin to suspect something is wrong. Police Chief Winter races to mount a response.

videos.title: Baggage
videos.overview: Berlin police scramble to contain the situation. Sam pressures Winter to meet his demands. Marsha discovers she's being watched.

videos.title: Switch
videos.overview: A shocking turn of events forces Sam to make a gesture of good faith. In London, Daniel calls on a friend to help look into what's happening in Berlin.

videos.title: Outage
videos.overview: Anger and frustration among the passengers begin to boil over—just as Sam comes to a frightening realization.

videos.title: Junction
videos.overview: To avoid further disaster, Sam must work with an unlikely ally. The enemy closes in on Marsha as Zahra and Daniel fear they've reached a dead end.

videos.title: Contact
videos.overview: Sam gambles on a dangerous tactic in hopes of outsmarting the police. Armed with new intel, Olivia tries to influence Winter's next move.

videos.title: Terminal
videos.overview: With the handover imminent, Sam is prepared to put his life on the line to save Marsha—and expose the truth.

awards: Nominated for 1 Primetime Emmy. 2 wins & 7 nominations total
